Documentation

Documentation: everything explained, with pictures

How we build your website, what each plan includes, what your client area looks like and what you see in your dashboard. The screenshots are examples, with made-up figures.

1How it works2The websites3The plans4The client area5Requesting a change6The dashboard7The online shop8SEO9Payment and loyalty

1. How it works

From order to launch

  1. You build your website online. Type of website, plan, options: the total price is shown before you order.
  2. You pay a 25% deposit. That is the starting signal: I begin building.
  3. I build your website. You follow each step in the “My order” tab of your client area.
  4. You receive your website and pay the rest. In one go, or in 6 or 12 interest-free instalments.
  5. Your plan starts. Hosting, security, updates and the month’s changes: we take care of everything.

4. The client area

Your whole website, in one place

Each client has their own area, on computer and on phone. All the tabs are visible at once, with no scrolling.

  • Dashboard: your visitors and the state of your website, at a glance.
  • Home: your plan, your website, your latest activity.
  • My order: tracking the build of your website, step by step.
  • My requests: you write what needs changing, and you follow its progress.
  • My shop: discount codes, sales, banner and holiday mode (online shops).
  • Referral: your code to share, and the free months you have earned.
  • My account: your details, your password, your plan and your invoices.

The “My shop” tab only appears for online shops.

Try the demo

5. Requesting a change

You write, Lia or Alex handles it

For each request, you choose who does it:

  • Lia, the AI, makes small and medium changes in 5 minutes, on a single page. She shows you the preview, and changes nothing without your approval.
  • Alex makes the bigger ones, by hand. If a request is too big for Lia, it goes to Alex.
  • A request can be cancelled free of charge within 24 hours, 3 times a month.
  • The month’s two counters are shown at the top of your client area.

All about Lia and Alex

6. The dashboard

What you see, depending on your plan

Visits are counted with no cookies and no personal data. The figures update every hour.

Chico and Power: the essentials

Titan: the full detail

  • Status lights: website online, HTTPS padlock, speed, server, disk space. Green means all is well.
  • Sources: Google, direct visits, social media or other websites.
  • Server: your website’s memory, the server load and disk space, shown as gauges.

7. The online shop

Your sales tools, set up in seconds

In the “My shop” tab, you manage your small promotions yourself. They do not count towards your changes for the month.

  • Discount codesIn % or in €, or free delivery. End date, minimum order, number of uses: it is all set in one form.
  • Quick salesFrom -5 to -70% on the whole shop or one category. Crossed-out prices appear on their own and disappear on the end date.
  • Announcement bannerA sentence at the top of the website, in a choice of four colours.
  • Holiday modeShop closed, or orders accepted with shipping on your return. A preview shows what your visitors will see.

8. SEO

Being found on Google

Every website starts with good foundations: titles and descriptions written for Google, a site map, fast pages that are easy to read on a phone. With Power and Titan, SEO is followed up every month: together we choose the words your customers type, and I add useful pages that link to your website.

SEO in detail The practical guides The pages created for our clients

9. Payment and loyalty

Pay simply, and get a thank you

  • A 25% deposit when you order, the rest when you receive the website, in one go or in 6 or 12 interest-free instalments.
  • Plan paid monthly, or yearly with 2 months free. No commitment.
  • Referral: when a referred friend’s website is online, you each get 1 month of your plan free.
  • A second website: 10% off its build.
